title: anchusa officinalis subsp. leucantha
intro: Anchusa officinalis subsp. leucantha, commonly known as White Alkanet, is a plant species in the borage family (Boraginaceae). It is a herbaceous perennial with a long history of use in traditional medicine, valued for its potential health benefits, including the reduction of inflammation, improvement of digestive issues, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of White Alkanet are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins that exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory effects. The bioactive constituents of White Alkanet may also contribute to its use in the treatment of various health conditions, including gastrointestinal issues, skin problems, and respiratory infections.
